description: SoraSpace site widgets. Every widget can be switched on or off per site; themes only set the starting state (theme.json widgets.enabled) and suggestions (widgets.suggested).
externalRules: Off by default on every theme. Only the site owner can switch it on.

Click-to-load: visitors first see a placeholder naming the provider and what loading shares, plus a plain link to open the content on the provider’s site. Nothing is requested from the provider until the visitor chooses to load it.
A visitor’s choice applies to that widget on that page view only unless the site owner enables a remembered choice; no SoraSpace data is sent to the provider.
Only allowlisted providers. The owner supplies a share link, never HTML or script; the link must match the provider’s accepted pattern.
Embeds use sandboxed iframes with referrerpolicy="no-referrer" (or strict-origin) and the provider’s privacy-enhanced mode where one exists.
The page Content Security Policy gains only the frame origins of providers actually switched on.
The click-to-load script is supplied and reviewed by the SoraSpace site manager, never by a theme or a tenant.

widgets.name: Featured panel
widgets.description: A panel over or beside the opening image showing a pinned item, or the newest post if nothing is pinned.

widgets.name: Quick links
widgets.description: Up to four shortcuts to the site’s own pages, shown in the featured panel.

widgets.name: Latest posts
widgets.description: The newest items from chosen pages.

widgets.name: Upcoming events
widgets.description: Dated posts that have not happened yet, soonest first. Past events drop off at the next publish.

widgets.name: Contact card
widgets.description: Opening hours, phone and a button to the Contact page.

widgets.name: Photo strip
widgets.description: A row of recent photos from Galleries.

widgets.name: Key numbers
widgets.description: Up to four short facts or figures the owner enters.

widgets.name: Testimonials
widgets.description: Genuine quotes the owner enters, each with the person’s name or initials. Never invented.

widgets.name: Social links
widgets.description: Plain links to the owner’s social profiles. No feeds, buttons or tracking scripts.

widgets.name: Illustrated map
widgets.description: A drawn map with numbered markers for approximate places (as on Explore). No map provider, no coordinates.

widgets.name: Map
widgets.description: An interactive map of one address or place.

widgets.name: Video
widgets.description: One video from a video service.

widgets.name: Audio player
widgets.description: A track, album, playlist or podcast episode player.

widgets.name: Social post
widgets.description: One public post from a social network.
